d: After more than four decades of searching, scientists have found the first evidence of an extraordinarily rare particle decay at CERN's Large Hadron Collider. The event occurs roughly once in every 10 billion beauty particles. The finding offers researchers a new way to investigate the zeptoverse, a realm of nature at distances far smaller than an atom. Could this help unlock the mysteries of dark matter and reveal new physics? How ancient Indian scriptures mentioned such small particles which in a way mimic the entire universe.
